blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Creamline regained its winning touch to stop Farm Fresh with a statement 25-19, 25-18, 25-18 win and secure the last twice-to-beat advantage in the PVL All-Filipino Conference Siklab Series semifinals on Saturday at Philsports Arena. After losing three straight games, Creamline responded to the challenge in a must-win game to rise to a 5-3 record tied with Choco Mucho and Farm Fresh. The Cool Smashers earned the second seed with superior points of 16 points. Defending champion Creamline will face sister team Choco Mucho, which placed third with 15 points, on Tuesday at the same venue in Pasig […]...
